caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a bronze or brass sculpted foot, colored in shades of greenish-brown and gold. The foot is oriented horizontally, with the toes on the left side and the ankle on the right. The toes are curled slightly upward and detailed with what seem to be decorative elements, including a circular ornamental motif with radiating lines and raised dots on the upper surface, located near the base of the toes. The overall surface of the object shows slight color variations and shading, giving it a metallic sheen, and the foot is elaborately decorated where the ankle would be. The background is plain and off-white, with four small, lightly drawn cross marks near the corners, possibly for alignment or framing purposes. Handwritten text is visible in the lower right corner, reading "Mary Jenness" and "Series C Frame 34."
title: Tie-back
